examples.english: On the tenth anniversary of the earthquake, memorial services were held in various locations.

notes:
A formal ceremony to mourn and honor someone who has died, often held on anniversaries of a person's death or of disasters. Distinct from a funeral (⟦{葬儀|そうぎ}→葬儀：15337_sougi⟧), which takes place shortly after death — a {追悼式|ついとうしき} can be held at any later date.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {追悼式|ついとうしき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧ — to hold a memorial service
- {追悼式|ついとうしき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参列|さんれつ}→参列：11888_sanretsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to attend a memorial service
- ⟦{合同|ごうどう}→合同：04185_goudou⟧{追悼式|ついとうしき} — joint memorial service

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{追悼|ついとう}→追悼：14312_tsuitou⟧ — mourning; remembrance (the act itself, without {式|しき})
- ⟦{慰霊祭|いれいさい}→慰霊祭：27133_ireisai⟧ — memorial rite (often for war dead or spirits)
- ⟦{法事|ほうじ}→法事：05634_houji⟧ — Buddhist memorial service (family-centered, on specific anniversaries)
